content:
If you missed yesterday’s "Surprise and Shine" event and don’t want to watch the full hour-long video, Apple’s YouTube channel has you covered. Check out the event highlights below.

Highlight reel shared by Apple

In addition to the iPhone Duo, Apple’s first foldable iPhone, Apple also unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max yesterday, along with the Apple Watch Series 12, Ultra 4, and the AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation.

The event ran for just under an hour and 20 minutes, featuring Apple’s signature style — executives speaking to camera, paired with marketing demos and product videos.

For those who don’t have time to sit through it all, Apple also released a fun highlight reel, with narration zipping viewers back and forth through the key announcements.

Apple has also uploaded individual full introduction clips for each product, all of which can be watched below.
